newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil weaker.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil weaker.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday, traders said.
Naphtha spot trade was thin, with a single buyer for pipeline spec pulling out as offers of product stayed scarce.
Gasoline barges were mixed. Regular rose but Eurograde was softer. Cargo sellers continued to eye firmer U.S Gulf trade.
High sulphur fuel oil tumbled again, contributing to a fall of over $10 since Friday.
Gas oil slid $5.25 on easier futures. Premiums for heating oil firmed. Low sulphur diesel cargo premiums weakened.
